name: retrieval_leakage
description: Retrieved context may contain benchmark answers or artifacts unavailable to the intended task setting.
evidence: Compare item metadata, source fields, and context-only performance under the local protocol.
repair: Remove leaked passages, refresh snapshots, or separate retrieval corpora from evaluation items.
limitations: Local metadata and corpora cannot prove absence of leakage.

name: context_insufficiency
description: The supplied context may not contain enough support for the gold answer.
repair: Add support spans, revise the item, or mark as unanswerable.
limitations: Lexical support checks do not establish semantic sufficiency.

name: contradiction
description: Retrieved evidence can contradict the gold answer or another retrieved passage.
repair: Remove contradictory evidence or update the gold answer after human review.
limitations: Offline contradiction checks are metadata-backed unless a local verifier is supplied.

name: distractor_injected_context
description: Distractor passages can change answers even when the original evidence is sufficient.
evidence: Full-vs-irrelevant-context score shift when a perturbation exists.
repair: Audit retrieval ranking and add distractor-resistant scoring checks.
limitations: Toy distractors are synthetic and do not model all retrieval failures.

name: answerable_unanswerable_imbalance
description: A benchmark may overrepresent answerable or unanswerable cases.
evidence: Answerable metadata counts and refusal correctness for unanswerable items.
repair: Balance answerability strata and report coverage.

name: unsupported_citations
description: Model answers or item labels may cite sources not present in retrieved evidence.
evidence: Citation metadata checked against local context/source fields.
repair: Require citation provenance and reject unsupported citations during item review.
limitations: Citation string checks are local evidence only.

name: evidence_position_bias
description: Models may rely on evidence position instead of evidence content.
evidence: Evidence-position metadata and shuffled-evidence score shift.
repair: Shuffle evidence during validation and balance answer positions.
limitations: Requires position metadata or shuffled-context variants.

name: faithfulness_helpfulness_conflict
description: A helpful answer can be unsupported by the supplied evidence.
evidence: Support-span checks and citation support signals.
repair: Separate helpfulness and faithfulness rubrics.
limitations: Semantic faithfulness requires human or local verifier review.

name: abstention_calibration
description: RAG systems may fail to abstain when evidence is missing or abstain despite adequate evidence.
evidence: Selective risk, coverage, appropriate refusal, and inappropriate refusal.
repair: Tune deferral thresholds and report risk-coverage curves.
limitations: Requires refusal/deferral metadata or observable abstention outputs.

name: environment_stochasticity
description: Agent outcomes may depend on environment seed or replay state.
repair: Record environment seeds and replay traces.
limitations: Scaffold only unless replay traces are supplied.

name: tool_call_parsing
description: Scores may reflect parser tolerance rather than task success.
evidence: Invalid call rate and schema mismatch counts.
repair: Validate tool calls with versioned schemas.

name: hidden_state_leakage
description: Agent state may carry information across episodes.
evidence: State hash changes and cross-episode trace review.
repair: Reset state and hash observations.

name: reward_hacking
description: Agent may maximize reward while violating task intent.
evidence: Plan/execution decomposition and judge decision metadata.
repair: Add constraint checks and human review of high-reward traces.

name: tool_schema_sensitivity
description: Performance may change due to superficial tool schema wording.
repair: Version and perturb tool schemas.

name: success_despite_bad_reasoning
description: The final state may be correct even when the trace reasoning or tool usage is invalid.
evidence: Plan/execution decomposition and judge decision metadata.
repair: Review traces with successful outcomes and low-quality plans.
limitations: Requires trace annotations or local judges.

name: distractor_tools
description: Irrelevant tools can change plans or outcomes.
repair: Run distractor-tool perturbations and report sensitivity.

name: step_budget_sensitivity
description: Scores may depend strongly on step budget rather than task capability.
evidence: Outcome changes across replayed step budgets.
repair: Report budget curves and redundant call rates.

name: redundant_call_rate
description: Repeated unnecessary calls can mask brittle planning.
evidence: Redundant call counts in trace schema.
repair: Penalize redundant calls or report efficiency separately.

name: label_ambiguity
description: Clinical labels or segmentations may have legitimate annotator disagreement.
repair: Adjudicate labels and report ambiguity strata.
limitations: Scaffold only; no clinical claims are made.

name: clinically_meaningless_metric_gain
description: Dice or IoU gains may not affect clinical decisions.
evidence: Clinical utility weights and severity-weighted scoring.
repair: Define utility thresholds with clinicians.

name: site_shift
description: Performance can vary across scanner, hospital, or population site.
repair: Stratify reports and add site-balanced validation.

name: fp_fn_asymmetry
description: False positives and false negatives can have different clinical costs.
repair: Report severity-weighted scoring and review high-cost errors.

name: calibration_under_shift
description: Uncertainty may become miscalibrated under site or population shift.
repair: Report calibration by site and defer high-uncertainty cases.

name: uncertainty_not_decision_useful
description: Uncertainty estimates may not identify clinically important errors.
repair: Evaluate uncertainty against decision-useful endpoints.

name: deferral_failure
description: Deferral may fail to route clinically risky cases to review.
repair: Tune deferral with clinical review thresholds.

name: temporal_leakage
description: Future graph information may leak into training or evaluation.
repair: Use strict temporal splits and report leakage matrix.

name: transductive_leakage
description: Evaluation entities may be visible during feature construction.
repair: Separate graph construction windows from test labels.

name: degree_artifact
description: Degree-only shortcuts may explain apparent fraud detection performance.
evidence: Degree-only baseline compared with model performance.
repair: Report degree-stratified performance and shortcut baselines.

name: metric_mismatch_under_imbalance
description: Accuracy can hide poor rare-positive detection.
repair: Report ranking metrics and class priors.
limitations: Requires scored predictions or class labels.

name: entity_overlap
description: The same entity may appear across train and test splits.
repair: Use entity-disjoint splits where appropriate.

name: graph_structure_shortcut
description: Graph topology alone may explain labels.
repair: Report topology baselines and remove leaky features.

name: label_propagation
description: Labels may propagate through homophilous neighborhoods.
evidence: Label propagation baseline and neighborhood label rate.
repair: Report label propagation baseline and temporal splits.

name: homophily_dependence
description: Performance may depend on a specific homophily regime.
repair: Report performance across graph regimes.

name: temporal_shift
description: Fraud patterns and graph structure may drift over time.
repair: Report recency windows and retraining assumptions.

name: github_overlap
description: Code tasks may overlap public repositories or examples.
evidence: Local solution similarity and repository metadata.
repair: Remove overlapped tasks or document provenance.
limitations: Local checks do not prove absence of memorization.

name: weak_hidden_tests
description: Passing tests may not imply functional correctness.
evidence: Public/hidden test counts and mutation-style metadata.
repair: Strengthen hidden tests and report coverage.

name: flaky_tests
description: Pass/fail may vary across reruns.
repair: Rerun tests and quarantine flaky tasks.

name: pass_k_instability
description: pass@k estimates may vary with sampling and small task counts.
repair: Report uncertainty and avoid overinterpreting small gaps.

name: package_version_sensitivity
description: Solutions may pass under one dependency version and fail under another.
evidence: Dependency lock hash and environment metadata.
repair: Lock dependencies and report version sensitivity.

name: prompt_ambiguity
description: Multiple reasonable implementations may satisfy an underspecified prompt.
evidence: Human ambiguity flags and hidden-test disagreement.
repair: Clarify prompt and add property tests.

name: solution_memorization
description: Solutions may be memorized from public examples.
repair: Remove public-overlap tasks or document exposure.

name: unit_test_overfitting
description: Models may overfit visible unit tests without solving the general task.
evidence: Public/hidden test ratio and mutation-style checks.
repair: Increase hidden tests and adversarial cases.

name: policy_staleness
description: Safety labels can become stale as policy versions change.
evidence: Policy version and label date metadata.
repair: Version policies and re-adjudicate stale labels.

name: judge_bias
description: Safety judges may prefer one wording, class, or refusal style.
repair: Use multi-judge panels and adjudication.
limitations: Judge agreement is not proof of safety validity.

name: refusal_overgeneralization
description: Models may refuse safe requests due to broad policy triggers.
repair: Separate safe/unsafe strata and calibrate refusal thresholds.
limitations: Requires safe/unsafe labels and refusal outputs.

name: adversarial_phrasing_sensitivity
description: Small paraphrases or roleplay framing can change safety labels or refusals.
repair: Report paraphrase strata and adversarial phrasing sensitivity.

name: multi_turn_dependence
description: Safety behavior may depend on prior turns or hidden conversational context.
repair: Separate single-turn and multi-turn reports.

name: rubric_ambiguity
description: Policy rubrics may leave cases with multiple reasonable labels.
repair: Adjudicate ambiguous rubric cases.
limitations: Requires human or judge panel labels.

name: false_safe_unsafe
description: False safe and false unsafe labels have different validity implications.
repair: Report confusion by risk category.

name: prompt_leakage
description: Prompts may leak policy labels or expected refusal behavior.
evidence: Prompt artifact and label leakage review.
repair: Remove policy-label artifacts from prompts.
limitations: Local text checks are not proof of no leakage.

name: text_only_baseline
description: A multimodal task may be solvable from text artifacts alone.
evidence: Text-only, caption-only, image-removed, or OCR-only baselines.
repair: Remove leaked text artifacts and report ablations.

name: ocr_shortcut
description: OCR text may carry the answer without visual reasoning.
repair: Report OCR availability and remove unintended answer text.
limitations: Requires OCR metadata or optional OCR tools.

name: crop_resolution_sensitivity
description: Scores may depend on crop or resolution artifacts.
repair: Standardize transforms and report sensitivity.

name: image_removed_sensitivity
description: The benchmark may remain solvable when the image is removed.
repair: Remove text leakage and report modality ablations.

name: caption_only_shortcut
description: Captions may contain enough information to answer without visual perception.
repair: Separate caption and image reasoning claims.

name: image_shuffled_artifact
description: Scores may be unaffected by pairing questions with wrong images.
repair: Run image-shuffle checks and remove text-only items.

name: audio_video_temporal_shortcut
description: Audio or video tasks may depend on metadata rather than temporal content.
repair: Report temporal ablations.

name: selective_risk
description: The error rate among answered items may remain high after abstention.
repair: Adjust deferral threshold and report risk-coverage tradeoffs.
limitations: Requires observable refusals or invalid-output markers.

name: inappropriate_refusal
description: A system may refuse items it would otherwise answer correctly.
repair: Audit refusal rubric and safe-answer pathways.
limitations: Correctness labels are needed to classify refusal appropriateness.

name: confidence_validity_correlation
description: Confidence or uncertainty may fail to track correctness or validity threats.
evidence: Confidence-correctness correlation and proxy uncertainty under paraphrase.
repair: Calibrate confidence and report uncertainty limitations.
limitations: Confidence may be unavailable; proxy signals are not calibrated probabilities.

name: deferral_failure
description: Deferral may not reduce risk or may fail on high-stakes items.
repair: Define deferral utility and require review for high-cost errors.
limitations: Utility depends on user-specified costs and domain context.
